column2: What is the unmet need and biological rationale?
column3: Natural-history or external controls, mechanism of action (MoA), literature benchmarks
column4:
• Disease name, etiology, and core symptoms
• Mechanism of action
• Literature review
• Prior landscape / similar products on the market

column2: Does the therapy improve a clinically meaningful endpoint?
column3: Pivotal trials, responder analyses, durability of response, surrogate endpoints
column4:
• Target effects (in vitro, in vivo, clinical)
• Dose-response results
• Inclusion / exclusion criteria
• Experimental & trial study design
• Efficacy endpoints & responder rates

column2: What harms occur shortly after dosing?
column3: Adverse events (AEs), laboratory trends, organ toxicity, infusion reactions, cytopenias
column4:
• Adverse Events by System Organ Class (SOC)
• Non-fatal adverse events & serious AEs
• Blood test results & organ function panels
• Expected & unexpected off-target effects

column2: Could the therapy cause malignancy or unintended genetic alterations?
column3: Integration-site analysis, off-target editing assays, clonality, tumor surveillance
column4:
• Off-target editing assays (in vitro / in vivo)
• Malignancy and insertional oncogenesis screening
• Genomic stability assessments

column2: Where does the vector/cell product go and what does it express?
column3: Animal biodistribution, transgene expression, vector shedding, biomarker kinetics
column4:
• In vivo biodistribution profiles
• Transgene expression & cellular kinetics
• Time-dependency of exposure

column2: Can host immune responses limit efficacy or cause severe toxicity?
column3: Anti-capsid antibodies, anti-transgene antibodies, cellular immunity, re-dosing constraints
column4:
• Baseline demographics & comorbidities
• Special populations (e.g., pediatric, renal/hepatic impairment)
• Neutralizing antibodies & T-cell responses

column2: Can commercial lots be manufactured consistently, potently, and safely?
column3: Identity, purity, potency, impurities, stability, comparability, process validation
column4:
• Assay validation
• Quality compliance & release specifications
• Facility inspection records & process consistency

column2: Were the trials conducted with rigorous compliance and ethical oversight?
column3: Protocol adherence, clinical site audits, GCP inspections
column4:
• Good Clinical Practices (GCP) compliance
• Protocol deviations & violations
• Financial disclosures & investigator conflicts

column2: What residual uncertainties remain, and how will long-term safety be tracked?
column3: Benefit–risk uncertainty, 15-year patient registries, confirmatory trials, CMC commitments
column4:
• Overall risk-benefit assessment criteria
• Long-term follow-up (LTFU) protocols (e.g., 15-year tracking)
• Pharmacovigilance and risk evaluation mitigation strategies (REMS)
